hero.tagline: Interfaces that feel as good as they work: fast, accessible and built to scale.

about.title: About me
about.body: Front-end developer with 3+ years of experience designing, building and maintaining enterprise-scale web applications. Fluent in React.js, Vue.js and TypeScript, with hands-on SSR/SSG experience in Next.js and Nuxt.js.

highlights.title: Technical ownership
highlights.text: Own the front-end of a product end to end and grow into an engineering-manager role.

highlights.title: Performance first
highlights.text: SEO, Core Web Vitals, service workers and smart caching are part of the job, not an afterthought.

highlights.title: Systems thinking
highlights.text: Design systems, Storybook and monorepos that keep big codebases calm.

bullets: Technical ownership of the front-end with Vue.js and Nuxt.js; gradually taking on engineering-manager responsibilities and architecture decisions.
Set up front-end reliability and monitoring: Sentry for errors and session tracking, PostHog for event tracking and behaviour analysis.
Implemented a service worker, smart caching strategies and push notifications for faster loads and offline access in the product's PWA.
Server state and client cache with TanStack Query across the project; built the product's logistics service.
Own SEO and Core Web Vitals; implemented and analysed product analytics to drive product decisions.
Contributed to AI-based features that simplify management workflows and improve UX.
Built PaaS and SaaS cloud products with Vue.js + TypeScript and Nuxt.js + TypeScript; server state with TanStack Query.
Wrote end-to-end tests with Cypress and designed test scenarios; monitored stability with Sentry.
Designed the team's design system and documented it fully in Storybook.
Designed a monorepo architecture and helped standardise the workflow across packages and apps.
Worked closely with product and back-end teams in a fast-moving Agile/Scrum setup with Jira.
Used the design system and OOP to tame front-end complexity; shipped i18n for a multilingual UI.

items.name: This portfolio
items.description: A bilingual portfolio where my face moves with the scroll.
features: Lenis smooth scroll synced with GSAP ScrollTrigger
120 WebP frames drawn to a canvas without dropped frames
Live theme and accent colour through CSS variables
Mirrored FA/EN (RTL/LTR) layout with logical properties
Static Next.js export and a PDF-to-JSON pipeline

craft: Frames preload progressively and are drawn to a canvas only when the frame changes.
Layout uses logical CSS properties, so RTL and LTR mirror without moving the face.
prefers-reduced-motion turns off smooth scroll and reveal animations.
